_comment: Main node config mAInd. Copy to .maind.json and adjust it to suit you. Superset.projects.json from brain — fields projects[].{id,name,repo,local_path,type} are compatible with brain, the rest are extensions maind.
_comment_node: Node identification. role: primary | secondary | mirror.
_comment_memory: agent-memory demon. Ports can be overridden via .env (AGENTMEMORY_PORT/AGENTMEMORY_STREAM_PORT) — env takes precedence over these values.
_comment_graph: Connection graph (topology between projects). adapter: federation (by default, the only layout is the graph per project in data/graphs/<id>.db + thin _index.db; communications derive'are removed from composer/Brain/.maind.graph.json/skills-lock) | disabled. Obsolete memory/graphify/networkx are accepted with a warning and normalized to federation. store_layout: hub (graphs in data/graphs/) | project-local (via projects[].graph_store=local — graph in the project repo itself). code graph (Serena) — separate MCP-layer above the project CODE (deploy --with-code; legacy --with-graphify), is not an adapter for this graph.
_comment_code_graph: CODE graph inside the project (separate per-project MCP, engine Serena via uvx). THE POLICY IS HERE, not in the code - edit it to your liking. Included on the project field projects[].code:true (legacy-alias graphify:true). ignores — what NOT to index (third-party + symlinked first-party packages are graphed as their own projects). workspace_ignores — for a project that is being developed TOGETHER with packages under packages/* (monorepo/consumer): packages DO NOT ignore (single graph), but we cut it vendor and nested **/vendor; mode is activated automatically if available packages/ or explicitly projects[].code_workspace. pre_index — background warm-up-indexing when turned on. feature_log_hook — SessionEnd-hook for committing commits to shared memory. The engine is redefined for the project: code_command/code_args({root})/code_server_name; language - code_language (str|list, interrupts language_by_type: mixed repo with python-code when type=node-package is graphed as python, without editing common constants).
_comment_agents: Node agent registry. definitions — descriptors for the agents who hang around here.

definitions.description: Senior architect for the brain vault

_comment_namespaces: Optional registry namespace-groups (id → {name, description}). Cross-project link isolation: edge A↔B in the graph is built only if A and B share at least one namespace (field projects[].namespaces). The registry is needed only for metadata and typo hints - membership is set in projects. No registry → namespace are free.
_comment_projects: Ecosystem projects. Minimum for compatibility with brain: id, name, repo, local_path, type. The remaining fields are extensions maind. namespaces: list of project groups - connections are isolated by group; no/empty → implicit 'default' (everything is connected as before); ['*'] → common infrastructure, communicates with EVERYONE namespace. Add. federation options: graph_store=local (project graph in <local_path>/.maind/graph.db, and not on the hub); vault_path — for derive doc-connections from Brain frontmatter; inter-project relationships not inferred from code/docks, announce in <local_path>/.maind.graph.json: {"links":[{"to":"getchat","type":"relates_to","plane":"runtime","note":"REST"}]}. docs_folders: doc-folders {id,vault,repo,visibility} — cache from frontmatter Brain (source of truth visibility — there, not here; names of the parties vault/repo may vary). repo = GitHub-slug owner/name; path to code - local_path (in brain-schema .projects.json repo = path, when importing → local_path).
_comment_integrations: Links to related projects. sync_direction: import | export | bidirectional.
_comment_mcp: MCP-servers to which the node connects (and which he publishes). emit_example (default-on, default true — P2.4): when deploy/sync next to the real one.mcp.json issue .mcp.json.example with placeholders (<ABS_PATH_TO_PROJECT>/<HOME>) instead machine-specific paths + lead .gitignore (real file - in .gitignore, .example — out to commit); opt-out — explicit false. perplexity_web (opt-in, disabled-by-default): hub-managed keyless-bridge perplexity-web — is rolled out into projects in the same way deploy/sync, what maind/Serena, instead of manual hardcode entry in each .mcp.json. enabled — global fan-out (per-project override projects[].perplexity_web:true|false). pool — browser pooling model (pool=demon+profile+window): 'default'/literal → shared pool (reuses the current login); 'per-project' → pool=id (your login for the project); 'per-namespace' → pool=ns-<namespace> (group login); per-project override projects[].perplexity_web_pool. bin — machine-local path to executable start.sh; MCP-clients run it directly, without shell-substitutions.
